derivation: from H3808 (לֹא) and H7355 (רָחַם); not pitied;
def: Lo-Ruchamah, the symbolic name of a son of Hosea

occurrences.text: And she conceived again, and bare a daughter. And God said unto him, Call her name Lo–ruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel; but I will utterly take them away.
Now when she had weaned Lo–ruhamah, she conceived, and bare a son.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
